globalAssumptions: Generated from the supplied data/sample_user_profiles.json content for profiles 31 through 40 only.
Annual utility period is 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31, with monthly calendar periods from 2025-06 through 2026-05.
Every profile in this batch includes electric, water/sewer, and waste utility categories because industrial, logistics, retail, and data-center sites make those categories plausible.

Gas utility data is generated only where the supplied gasUtilityProvider is not Unknown, None, No gas, or empty; Microsoft Columbia Data Center and QTS Richmond Data Center therefore intentionally omit gas utility records.
Synthetic masked account numbers are deterministic fixture values and are not actual private account numbers.
Annual usage and cost fields are computed from monthly records; average unit costs are computed from annual cost divided by annual usage.
Total monthly cost values are blended synthetic bill totals designed for calculator, preview, and intake-summary testing, not tariff-accurate bills.
